name: Black knights

variantInfo.name: Black Knight
notes: Level 33 Wilderness Black Knight south of the Bandit Camp (Lava Maze area); 42 hitpoints.
Very high melee and ranged defence (+70 to +76) but negative magic defence (-11); attack with magic.
Spawns south of the Bandit Camp and north-east of the Bone Yard.

locationComparison.name: Black Knights (Wilderness)
notes: 9 spawns south of the Bandit Camp plus 7 north-east of the Bone Yard, all level 33 Wilderness.
Multicombat, cannon placement and safespots are not wiki-stated; conservative defaults are used.

taskNotes: Black knights are assigned only by Krystilia and must be killed in the Wilderness to count; there is no combat, Slayer or quest requirement.
slayerTargetId 254 is SYNTHETIC (C2/C3 allocation contract); the real SLAYER_TARGET varp value is a QA live-verify item.
The Wilderness Black Knights spawn south of the Bandit Camp (Lava Maze) and north-east of the Bone Yard, NOT the members-only White Knight castle or quest black knights.
They have very high melee and ranged defence (+70 to +76) but a negative magic defence (-11), so magic is by far the fastest style.
No task extension unlock exists for Black knights.
recommendedMethod: Attack the level 33 Wilderness Black Knights with magic; their magic defence is negative (-11) while melee and ranged defence are very high (+70 to +76). Bring Wilderness-appropriate risk gear.
